anti_trude_vector.medium: Dual-plane brass astrolabe & solstice cardo-decumanus founding instrument coupled to a subterranean brick-cellar teratological cutaway and two-horn observatory dilemma ledger

canonical_stones.source: Astronomers summoned to establish site and day laid out cardo and decumanus along the solstice sun path, divided the map into 12 houses of the zodiac for temple influence, and angled every gate and tower to lunar eclipses and planetary conjunctions.
canonical_stones.mechanism: Interactive brass astrolabe with draggable cardo meridian, solstice decumanus axis, 4 lunar-eclipse & syzygy gate verniers, and 12 consecratable zodiac temple zones computing exact celestialPrecision in [0, 1].

canonical_stones.source: Streets and squares teem with cripples, dwarfs, hunchbacks, obese men, and women with beards; guttural howls rise from cellars and lofts hiding children with three heads or six legs.
canonical_stones.mechanism: As celestialPrecision approaches 1.0, monstrousBirthShare rises monotonically to 1.0 while classicalPerfectionShare remains strictly 0.0 across every parameter setting; peering into cellars opens vaulted brick cellars and timber lofts revealing three-headed and six-legged prodigies.

canonical_stones.source: Astronomers return to observatory rolls facing an irresolvable choice: admit all their calculations were wrong and unable to describe the heavens, OR reveal that the order of the gods is reflected exactly in the city of monsters.
canonical_stones.mechanism: Interactive observatory dilemma fork switching between undecided, admitCalculationsWrong (crimson errata slashes across ephemeris tables despite 0.00 arcsec sky error), and confessGodsOrderIsMonsters (constellation projection rays descending from the 12 zodiac temples directly into each street and cellar prodigy).

invariants.impossible_apollonian_escape: classicalPerfectionShare === 0.0 for all cardoOffsetDeg, decumanusOffsetDeg, eclipseTuning, and houseLocks
